decisions.reason: Report cites the up-only and lo-only branches (renderer-excerpt.ts:25-30), explains that the last 48;2 bg from a full cell stays latched because RESET only fires on a fully transparent cell or at row end, maps the leakage to the right-edge outline/Z/heart columns that move with animation, and prescribes ESC[49m or an explicit reset per half-filled cell rather than blaming art or the terminal.

Report identifies the trailing-space trim (renderer-excerpt.ts:41) and the pipeline's whitespace stripping as jointly leaving surplus columns of a wider frame unwritten, and gives a two-part fix: pad/erase (ESC[K or default-bg spaces) through the full rectangle plus exempt sprite rows from pipeline trimming, keeping SGR state explicit.

Report reads the digest report correctly: tail2 mismatch with 23 differing cells (explicitly the systematic 1-col left shift plus extra cells, beyond the visible cluster), attributes it to hand-ported data drift not the renderer, explains the excerpt-based regression for a different frame never covered tail2, and proposes a full-frame sha256 digest gate against trusted source art in CI.

Report uses the CI evidence: PASS then idle with live Timeout handles, planner re-arming setTimeout forever, channel-ui hosts mounting the header and finishing without unmounting, interactive kept alive by TTY/stdin; the one-line fix is timer.unref() on each re-armed tick so tests can exit without stopping animation globally.

The checklist consolidates complete per-cell SGR, reset discipline, full-width/erase semantics, pipeline-trim independence, source-backed all-frame digests, and timer/lifecycle hygiene; the pre-flip audit covers full-frame digests, edge/frame-switch golden diffs, timer unref and liveness regression, host inventory of mounts without unmount, and staged rollout.
